translations.name: Kansas Adult Education Centers (GED)
translations.description: Kansas Adult Education Centers help people get a GED or learn new skills. For a GED, you must be age 16 or older and not enrolled in high school. If you are 16 or 17, extra rules apply. Some programs also let you work toward a GED and job training at the same time. Find a center near you or call 785-430-4289.
translations.website_description: Find Kansas adult education centers for GED and English classes.
